Reasons for ending education
• Lack of higher education facilities.
• No chance of jobs
• Early marriages

Two most important reasons
• Early marriage
• Lack of higher education facilities
Due to lack of education facilities within the village girls left their education and also get married in early age.

I got education up to grade 4 but after that for high school my father did not allow me to go another nearby village. I still read my elder brothers grade 10 books whenever I am free, because I always wanted to be a teacher.
My brother seldom brings me story books and newspaper and I pass my time by reading these.
I help out my mother in daily chores; making fodder for livestock.
I do all the cleaning of our house by myself and the cooking too. I also help out my mother while washing wheat, feeding of livestock is also my responsibility.
Girls could not complete their education because there is no higher school for girls in the village.

My cousin has completed her education and now she is doctor. She get married but still helps her family. She supports her parents. She has financially supported her sister’s wedding and in arranging brothers studies.

If someone complete their education they have to go outside village or go to city. If parents allow them. After completing their education they got jobs in schools or after education they get married. Then it depends on their in laws they allow her to do job or not.
